name: Joy Sparkes
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Hi, I’m Joy Sparkes. I’ve been practising as a psychotherapist and counsellor since 2019, and I started Neuro Affirming Therapy to honour neurodiversity by embracing both strengths and challenges in how people experience the world. My training spans integrative psychotherapy, psychology (honours), and additional work in EMDR, DBT, schema therapy, trauma, neurodiversity and breathwork.

name: Jen Allen
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: As a skilled psychotherapist I bring over 25 years of extensive experience in helping individuals improve their relationship dynamics, at work or at play. I specialise in trauma-informed care and inclusive practices, I employ a compassionate and holistic approach to therapy, recognising the profound impact of systemic inequalities and adverse experiences on mental health and relational well-being. By integrating evidence-based techniques with a deep understanding of the complex interplay between trauma, identity, and relational well-being, I work to provide the space and the support necessary for my clients to achieve meaningful and sustained change. I work with people dealing with a wide range of issues, including anxiety, addictions, trauma, relationship difficulties, and more, providing a safe and confidential space for clients to gain insights and achieve lasting personal growth and well-being.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Posttraumatic stress disorder, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing

name: Benjamin Watkins
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Director and Principal Therapist at Watkins Therapy Group & UrSpace EAP, providing practical, down-to-earth counselling support with a strong focus on real-world outcomes. WTG offers individual counselling, workplace Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services, and Mental Health First Aid (MHFA) training, supporting individuals, businesses, sporting associations and community organisations across Australia. With in-person, phone and telehealth options available, WTG is focused on helping people improve well-being, build resilience and access meaningful support when it matters most.

name: Andy Simpson
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Andy Simpson Counselling provides counselling to children through to young adults. He firmly believes that everyone deserves support and understanding, and he is enthusiastic about helping his clients achieve their goals.​ Andy is a certified registered counsellor with over 17 years of experience supporting children, adolescents, and young adults and their families in overcoming daily challenges through various mediums, including counselling, group work, and peer support. His counselling journey began after facing personal challenges, including neurodiversity and mental ill-health.
specialties: Gay, Lesbian & Bisexual issues, Sex and sexual issues, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing
